evidence.note: Authentication record defines only the Aad kind, with AuthorizationUri, Resource, and DefaultClientApplication. No PKCE or token refresh is implemented by the connector.
Web.Contents(BapEndpoint) is called on the live server-null navigation path (line 90).
Web.Contents is called on the live AuthorizationUri path (line 340) to read the WWW-Authenticate header.
Sql.Database(validatedServer, database, sqlOptions) is the data access for server-specific calls.
The server parameter is a host name such as orgname.crm.dynamics.com (sample at line 106), so it is the connection target.
The optional options nullable record is a connector settings parameter, validated at line 66.

options-fields.text: CreateNavigationProperties (nullable logical, default true; visible option at OptionsMap line 128, documented at lines 108 and 98). Hidden, not public-facing: EnableDisplayNames (line 130) and UnsafeTypeConversions (line 131). ValidateOptions (lines 258-281) rejects any other key.

evidence.note: Defines the accepted options and their types, defaults, and hidden flags.
The options record type declares CreateNavigationProperties and the options caption and description.
A single Json.Document(Web.Contents(BapEndpoint)) call with no next link or skip token. Only response[value] is read.
Json.Document parses the BAP environment list response.
Sql.Database returns rows as driver-provided tables.
Sql.Database supplies the column names and types of the returned data tables.
The declared table type applies only to the environment navigation table, which the definition excludes, so it does not count as declared-schema.
The live Web.Contents data request has no ManualStatusHandling, so status handling is left to Power Query.
Web.Contents sets ManualStatusHandling={401} and reads the WWW-Authenticate header from the response.
Documentation.Name, Caption, and LongDescription are set on the function type.
server and options have Documentation.FieldCaption and FieldDescription.
CreateNavigationProperties has a FieldCaption and SampleValues.
server has Documentation.SampleValues.
Navigator rows are built at runtime from the BAP environments list.
Data is a table with NavigationTable.ItemKind Database, so each environment row opens a further navigation table. IsLeaf is not set explicitly.
Each environment's Data column is an indirect table that calls CommonDataService.Database, which opens the entity list.
TestConnection returns the entry function name CommonDataService.Database with ServerFromPath(path) as its arguments. It does not make a separate probe call.
Folding is delegated to Sql.Database.
Table.View on the navTable implements OnNativeQuery, which runs Value.NativeQuery.

native-query-enabled.text: Enabled by Table.View(navTable, [OnNativeQuery = ...]) on the Sql.Database navigation table (lines 74-89), which runs Value.NativeQuery. ApplyDisplayNamesOption builds a SqlDatabase.View with GetNativeQuery when DisplayNames is set (lines 298-318).

evidence.note: OnNativeQuery handler on the Table.View.
Builds the SqlDatabase.View with GetNativeQuery and NativeQueryOptions.
The connector is one .pq file with no pqm module loading.
Strings are loaded through Extension.LoadString.
Icons are loaded through Extension.Contents (Dataverse PNG files).
No Diagnostics.Trace call exists in the file.
No export, job, or polling logic exists.
The connector only reads data. There are no Action functions.
